diagnoses: Anxiety Disorder with Somatic Symptoms (e.g., Panic Attack)
Early-Stage Mitral Valve Prolapse (MVP) or Functional Heart Disorder
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with Atypical Chest Pain

clinicalTestsDue.testName: Electrocardiogram (ECG) with Stress Test (Treadmill or Pharmacological)
clinicalTestsDue.clinicalReason: Rule out cardiac ischemia, arrhythmias (e.g., MVP, atrial fibrillation), or functional cardiac disorders. Stress testing evaluates exertional dyspnea and palpitations.
Assess for anemia (could explain dizziness), infection, or inflammatory markers (e.g., costochondritis).

clinicalTestsDue.testName: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP) + Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
clinicalTestsDue.clinicalReason: Evaluate electrolytes (e.g., hypokalemia/hyponatremia for palpitations), renal/liver function, and glucose (rule out metabolic causes of dizziness).
Rule out acute myocardial infarction or cardiac injury, especially given chest pain.
Detect intermittent arrhythmias (e.g., palpitations, atrial fibrillation) not captured on resting ECG.
Rule out structural abnormalities (e.g., pneumothorax, aortic dissection), pleural effusion, or costochondral calcification.
Assess valvular function (e.g., MVP), ventricular function, and pericardial effusion. Gold standard for cardiac structural evaluation.
Quantify psychological symptoms contributing to somatic complaints (e.g., palpitations, chest pain).
Confirm or rule out GERD as a cause of atypical chest pain (if symptoms persist after cardiac evaluation).
Hypothyroidism can cause fatigue, dizziness, and palpitations. Hyperthyroidism may exacerbate anxiety symptoms.

clinicalTestsDue.testName: Blood Gas Analysis (if severe dyspnea persists)
clinicalTestsDue.clinicalReason: Assess for hypoxia or hypercapnia (e.g., respiratory cause of dizziness).
